senses.zh_definition: 英语姓氏 Maisey；属于人名专名，输入材料未提供其作为马来语普通词的释义。
senses.en_definition: An English surname of Norman origin; a proper name rather than an established Malay common word.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga Inggeris yang berasal daripada tradisi penamaan Norman; digunakan sebagai kata nama khas.
senses.nuances: 实际书写应大写为 Maisey。此处马来语说明为编写释义，并非 DBP 原文；unverified 表示其马来语词条资格未获确认。以下为姓名组合示例，未验证为高频搭配。姓氏来源见 [Dictionary of American Family Names，经 Ancestry 收录](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/maisey)。

senses.zh_definition: 英语女性名字 Maisey，为 Maisie 的拼写变体。
senses.en_definition: A feminine English given name, a spelling variant of Maisie.
senses.ms_definition: Nama peribadi perempuan dalam bahasa Inggeris yang merupakan variasi ejaan Maisie.
senses.nuances: 不能根据这个名字推断某人的国籍、族群或具体身份；作为名字与作为姓氏的来源应分别处理。名字读音及变体关系见 [Behind the Name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/maisey/)。以下为姓名使用组合，非固定短语。

etymology.historical_story: Maisey illustrates how identical spellings can belong to different naming histories. As a surname, it is linked to French place names, including Maizy and Grandcamp-Maisy, through Norman naming traditions. As a feminine given name, it is recorded as a variant of Maisie. These histories should remain separate: a particular person's name cannot be assigned an origin from spelling alone.
